name: ch.opencaselaw/swiss-caselaw
title: OpenCaseLaw — Swiss Caselaw, Statutes & Doctrine
description: 1,050,000+ published Swiss court decisions (federal + cantonal + ECtHR, 1875–today, DE/FR/IT), 5,525 federal + 15,600 cantonal statutes, 1,146 scholarly commentaries, 24,000+ open-access scholarship records, federal administrative practice (SECO/ESTV/SEM/BAFU), Federal Council Botschaften, and a 9.99M-edge citation graph. 42 specialised tools: full-text search with cross-language matching, citation-graph and appeal-chain traversal, statute/commentary/practice lookup, per-Erwägung pinpoint retrieval, leading-case discovery, and a verification layer (cite/check_claim_support/attest_response) that catches hallucinated case references before answers ship. Daily refresh, CC0 data (ECtHR texts © ECHR-CEDH), MIT code, no API key, no registration.
